value.rationale: This natural two-twin construction gives a uniform bounded-degree expander family with an entire high-dimensional quotient subspace lattice of ideals and q-to-a-quadratic number of ideals; it rigorously falsifies a recent structural simplicity assertion even under the stricter basic-ideal definition. Exact formulas over every finite field and a small reproducible witness yield a motivated and reusable boundary for future algebraic expansion hypotheses.
